meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，系统会新增 Telegram 频道支持：复制并注册适配器、安装固定依赖，您在 BotFather 创建机器人并完成配对后，就能通过 Telegram 与它收发消息。
howto.when: 当您需要为系统接入 Telegram 频道、让机器人能通过 Telegram 对话时使用，例如在初始化代理或管理频道时。

say.text: 帮我给项目添加 Telegram 集成
say.note: Claude 会准备组件并指导您创建机器人。

say.text: 接入 Telegram，我想通过它跟机器人聊天
say.note: Claude 会安装依赖并引导您完成配对。

say.text: 用 add-telegram 技能配置 Telegram 通道
say.note: Claude 将按步骤执行并提示您操作 BotFather。

howto.what_en: Adds Telegram channel support: copies and registers the Telegram adapter, installs a pinned dependency, and after you create and pair a bot, the system can exchange messages over Telegram.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to add Telegram as a chat channel, e.g., during setup or when managing channels.

say_en.text: Add Telegram integration to my project
say_en.note: Claude will set up components and guide you through bot creation.

say_en.text: Set up Telegram so I can chat with the bot
say_en.note: Claude will install dependencies and walk you through pairing.

say_en.text: Use the add-telegram skill to configure a Telegram channel
say_en.note: Claude will run the steps and prompt you to use BotFather.
